en-US.name: Music Cloud
en-US.summary: Stream your own personal music library.
en-US.description: Music Cloud streams your own uploaded music library from the cloud. Ask it to play a song or an artist from your collection.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Music Cloud to play Sao Paulo
Alexa, ask Music Cloud to play some Sia
Alexa, ask Music Cloud to shuffle my music
